This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Leadership and mentoring of performance digital teams.

Role Details:

Working as a Project Officer in a small, highly skilled team, you will operate in a diverse and intellectually stimulating environment to provide an effective and efficient claims service, across SA Health, for the classes of insurance managed in-house by Insurance Services team.

The role offers exposure to a broad range of complex insurance, claims management, governance and risk-rated matters, providing opportunities to collaborate with senior stakeholders, analyse data and support strategic decision-making.

The Project Officer will develop and maintain close working relationships with officers across SA Health, the South Australian Government Financing Authority (SAFA), Loss Assessors and health related Non-Government Organisation, to ensure effective delivery of Governance Advisory projects and SA Health's Insurance Services.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

Manage competing priorities with professionalism and agility, delivering high-quality outcomes in a dynamic environment, while maintaining strong record management practices and contributing to a collaborative, high-performing team culture.

Assist with the administration, development and review of SA Health's insurance services functions managed the Insurance Services team.

Conduct an initial assessment of reported incidents, (hospital visitor, data breach) ensuring information is accurate and complete in all respects and advise the client on management of issues associated with incidents.

Conduct an initial assessment of reported claims, Property, Public Liability and Professional Indemnity and make claim determination.

Advise the client whether the incident is an approved claim under the insurance program and manage the claim through to completion.

Compile SA Health's yearly questionnaire response to (SAFA), involving analysing data integrity and follow-up of submitted questionnaire returns by LHNs-SAAS-NGOs and briefing the CE for approval prior to submission to SAFA.

To be successful you will have:

The ability to communicate both orally and in writing with a wide range of individuals and organisations, including consumers, community or professional groups, departmental, Local government, and other State Government officers at varying levels and to exercise discretion in relation to sensitive issues and maintain confidentiality.

The ability to research and gather information relevant to Insurance Services, and project development using analytical and investigative skills, and to draft high-quality briefings, minutes and reports.

Good interpersonal and conflict resolution skills which contribute to the development of effective working relationships with a wide range of people, and which foster trust and cooperation.

Effective skills in time management, including the ability to organise workflow to determine priorities and meet deadlines while working with limited direction.

A strong commitment and demonstrated ability to maintain flexibility, contribute as a team member and value diversity.

Demonstrated ability to organise, implement and coordinate concurrent projects and to successfully manage programs and projects of some complexity.

Ability to interpret and understand policies and instructions.

If this sounds like you, then we encourage you to apply.

Why you'll love it here - benefits that matter:

We know a great career is about more than the work you do. It is also about feeling supported, valued, and able to thrive. At SA Health, you will enjoy:

A collaborative team environment, working alongside people committed to best practice and meaningful impact.

Flexible work options and tailored arrangements to help you balance work and life.

Recognition and growth, celebrating achievements and supporting development opportunities across SA Health.

Health and fitness perks, including discounted Fitness Passport memberships and free flu vaccinations.

Wellbeing support, including confidential Employee Assistance Program services for you and your family.

Job Title: Aircraft Painter
Salary: $80,000 per annum plus depending on skills and experience
Global Aircraft Services Pty Ltd

Company Overview:
Join our team at Global Aircraft Services Pty Ltd, a leading provider of aircraft maintenance and refurbishment services. We specialize in maintaining and enhancing the appearance and performance of a wide range of aircraft. As an aircraft painter with us, you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge aircraft projects in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Position Overview:
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Aircraft Painter to join our Cairns based team on a full-time basis. The ideal candidate will have experience in painting aircraft exteriors, interiors, and components to meet high-quality standards. Attention to detail, precision, and adherence to safety protocols are essential for success in this role.

Key Responsibilities:
· Prepare aircraft surfaces for painting by cleaning, sanding, masking, and priming.
· Mix and apply paint according to specifications, ensuring color match and consistency.
· Apply paint using spray guns, brushes, and rollers to achieve desired finish.
· Perform touch-up and detail work to ensure a flawless final product.
· Inspect completed work to ensure it meets quality standards and specifications.
· Adhere to safety procedures and regulations at all times to prevent accidents and ensure a safe working environment.
· Maintain painting equipment and tools in good working condition.
· Collaborate with team members to ensure efficient workflow and timely completion of projects.

Competencies:
1. Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in aircraft painting or a related field.
2. Knowledge: Understanding of aircraft painting techniques, materials, and equipment.
3. Attention to Detail: Ability to perform precise and meticulous work to achieve high-quality results.
4. Color Matching: Skill in matching paint colors and ensuring uniformity across aircraft surfaces.
5. Safety Consciousness: Commitment to following safety procedures and protocols to prevent accidents and ensure a safe work environment.
6. Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with team members to achieve common goals.
7. Time Management: Capacity to prioritize tasks and manage time efficiently to meet project deadlines.
8. Adaptability: Flexibility to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities and requirements.
9. Problem-Solving: Ability to identify and troubleshoot issues related to painting processes and equipment.
10. Communication: Clear and effective communication skills to convey instructions, updates, and concerns to team members and supervisors.

Education and Certification:
Completion of a formal training program in aircraft related safety procedures.
Certification in aircraft painting or related field.
If you are a skilled aircraft painter looking to join a dynamic team and contribute to exciting aircraft projects, we encourage you to apply. We offer competitive compensation, opportunities for career advancement, and a supportive work environment dedicated to excellence and safety. Join us in shaping the future of aircraft maintenance and refurbishment!

Salary: $80,000 per annum plus depending on skills and experience.

This advertisement was first published on 05 July 2026
Applications and expressions of interest close on 05 August 2026

Job description:

Why join us at Alliance?

- We value your time - great company culture where flexibility and work-life balance are valued
- Grow your skills and expertise - work for a company that supports your professional development
- Wellbeing allowance - we care about your wellbeing
- Social events - company social events
- Friendly workplace - enjoy working in a friendly, professional environment

About us:

Alliance Geotechnical is an established and highly regarded geotechnical and environmental engineering consultancy with a proven track record in providing engineering and testing services on large scale civil infrastructure projects. Established in 2003, we have over 150 employees based in our office and materials testing laboratory in Seven Hills, NSW. Alliance Geotechnical offers a great working culture and competitive remuneration package.

To learn more about Alliance and what we can offer you, please go to https://allgeo.com.au/about/#benefits.

The opportunity

We are looking for a highly driven Geotechnical Engineer to join our established Sydney Geotechnical Engineering team of approx. 45 people. You’ll be involved in investigations, analysis and construction support, working alongside experienced engineers and scientists in a genuinely supportive, collaborative environment. Expect a combination of field, lab and office work with some travel to regional NSW sites when projects require it.

Key responsibilities

- Fieldwork planning including subcontractor engagement and preparation of documentation contributing to safe, efficient site operations.
- Supervision of test pit excavation and borehole drilling operations, soil/rock logging to AS 1726, sampling, in-situ testing and on-site 
coordination.
- Scheduling of laboratory testing, collation and interpretation of results with guidance and review.
- Preparation of factual logs, figures and draft report sections, participation in quality reviews to ensure high technical standards.
- Assistance with geotechnical analysis and provision of practical inputs for foundations, retaining structures, slopes, pavements and earthworks.
- Clear communication with internal teams and clients, seeking support and feedback as necessary.

You will experience engineering projects from concept through to construction—not just desktop work—as we support your development into a well-rounded geotechnical engineer or engineering geologist.

About you

- Tertiary qualification in Civil/Geotechnical Engineering or Engineering Geology.
- Driver’s licence and appetite for fieldwork (metro and occasional regional NSW).
- Clear written and verbal communication with strong time-management and organisational skills.
- Solid Microsoft Office skills and a willingness to learn industry software and data systems.
- Familiarity with Australian Standards (e.g., AS 1726) and a practical, safety-first mindset.

What we offer

- Flexible, people-first culture that respects work–life balance.
- Structured graduate development program and mentorship with clear feedback and on-the-job coaching (you will always know what “good” looks like, and why).
- Exposure to a wide range of projects ranging from small residential to major city-shaping infrastructure.
- Wellbeing allowance, regular social events, and a friendly, professional team.
- Real progression pathways with opportunity to grow into providing design inputs, construction phase services, specialist assessments and more.

Salary Range: $79,423 - $83,000

How to apply

Please send your resume, cover letter and a copy of your degree.
